digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate; BindingStore/reconciler; lifecycle protocol; Jira adapter; CLI registry; code-review policy discovery
propositions: Five recovered RP-02 through RP-06 decisions require evidence-backed research and maintainer approval before becoming implementation stories, preserving prior architectural intent, hard-won bug/test behavior, and resolving implementation-critical ambiguities.

RP-02 BindingStore must provide ordered exact-match retirement recovery at an explicit live-operation boundary: the durable tombstone is the retirement intent; recovery removes the live forward/reverse pair only when tombstone, forward, and reverse identities exactly agree; repeat is a no-op; ambiguity or replacement failure safety-aborts.

RP-03 outbound lifecycle protocol must implement a scoped finite-pass fuse: maximum 3 consecutive exhausted provider-suspect logical outcomes across at least 2 tickets opens endpoint-family scope; at least 2 independent endpoint families required for provider scope; success resets consecutive counter; permanent 4xx/auth/config/quota/rate-limit/per-issue signals retain direct scopes.

RP-06 code-review discovery must honor effective applicability policy with typed skip/non-applicable provenance, enforce explicit non-empty repository-relative globs for project-criteria applies_to, persist versioned per-unit discovery trace for retry/audit, implement Option-B runtime failure policy with cross-invocation retry, and provide explicit review-plan --retry override with fresh attempt budgets.

CLI registry migration must normalize canonical help for every visible command before RP-04 operation-snapshot composition, route overview/help/unknown-command before config materialization/store mount/handler resolution, and support exact-alias help reuse and compatibility-shim help with canonical replacement naming.
